item.title: New abilities for Legends: Z-A Megas, and Pokémon Champions release date

br.br:
Pokémon Champions, the battle-focused Switch game, has been announced to be released on April 8th. It will be available on mobile at a later date. Along with this, abilities for new Mega Evolutions from Legends: Z-A were announced:
Mega Meganium has a new ability Mega Sol, which uses moves as if the weather was harsh sunlight (without that weather being active for the whole field). Mega Emboar has the ability Mold Breaker. Mega Feraligatr has a new ability Dragonize, which turns Normal-type moves into Dragon-type moves.

item.title: New games Pokémon Winds & Pokémon Waves announced!
item.description:
È appena andato in onda un nuovo Pokémon Presents, che annuncia una nuovissima coppia di giochi Pokémon: Pokémon Winds & Onde Pokémon! Usciranno il prossimo anno, 2027, esclusivamente su Nintendo Switch 2. La nuova regione sembra essere composta da diverse isole; il sito ufficiale descrive un mondo aperto da esplorare, con bellissime isole battute dal vento e un vasto oceano con onde scintillanti che si alzano e si alzano.
I tre Pokémon Primo Partner sono stati brevemente introdotti nel trailer:
Browt, il Pokémon Pulcino - Tipo Erba Pombon, il Pokémon Cucciolo - Tipo Fuoco Gecqua, il Pokémon Geco dell'Acqua - Tipo Acqua
Inoltre in Pokémon Presents, Mega Garchomp Z è stato ufficialmente rivelato. Trailer e screenshot qui sotto.

item.title: Pokémon FireRed & LeafGreen to be re-released on Switch, and Pokémon Presents upcoming

br.br:
This coming Friday, February 27th, will be Pokémon Day! This is the annual celebration that marks the original release of Pokémon Red & Green in Japan. There will be a Pokémon Presents with news about upcoming games, believed to include details of the next generation of Pokémon games! The Pokémon Company have also announced that the Game Boy Advance games, Pokémon FireRed & LeafGreen, will be released on the Nintendo Switch following the Pokémon Presents. item.title: Mega Lucario Z revealed for Legends: Z-A DLC

br.br:
A new trailer has dropped and it reveals an additional Mega Evolution for Lucario: Mega Lucario Z. It will be available in the Mega Dimensions DLC for Pokémon Legends: Z-A. Here is the trailer:
Mega Lucario Z remains Fighting/Steel type. This form is listed as a Z Mega Evolution, which need less time to fire off moves but burn through Mega Power very quickly. Also announced is a Side Mission to obtain Mewtwo and its Mega stones. It's available from the Link Play menu > Mystery Gift > Get via internet.
